name: Regular Meeting of the Parks & Recreation Commission
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  (562) 865-6262

  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 26, 2023
  6:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the Parks and Recreation Commission is asked to fill out a
speaker card and give that card to staff prior to the commencement of the meeting. Public
comments may also be submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before
4:00 pm on the date of the meeting. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the
next 20 minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public submits
a speaker card for an item on the agenda, the public comment will be given when the
Commission addresses the item. Public comments for items not listed on the agenda will
be heard at this time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the Commission is prohibited
from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the matter to
staff or to a subsequent meeting.

NEW BUSINESS

  1. Updated Parks & Recreation Fee Schedule
  2. Update on AJ Padelford Expansion Project- Demolition of Purchased Properties
  & Handball Wall
  3. Recap of New Spring Adventure Camp and plans for additional camps
  4. New and upcoming programming/events for Summer-Fall 2023
  5. Fundraising for Repair & Maintenance of Artesia Park Snack Bar

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
Next Regular Parks and Recreation Commission Meeting - Wednesday, October 25,
2023, at 6:00 P.M.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact City Hall at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
